name: curating-decision-records
title_zh: 决策记录越攒越厚时，替你判谁该被取代
tagline_zh: ADR、RFC、复盘越写越多，翻起来像考古？它专管「新记录是否取代旧的」：归档、恢复、修剪，让活跃集始终读得下去。
tagline_en: When ADRs, RFCs and postmortems pile up, it decides which new record supersedes which old one — archiving.
desc_en: Use when adding, auditing, pruning, archiving, restoring, or reviewing durable decision records — architecture decisions, design notes, RFCs, postmortems. Also use when a new record may supersede an existing one, or when the active set has grown hard to read. DO NOT invoke to propose a code removal — route that to ledger:proving-code-is-dead.
why_zh: 把「取代」当一等公民：新记录落笔时就判定它顶掉谁，旧记录自动退场，而不是靠人记得手动改状态。
why_en: Treats supersession as first-class: a new record declares what it replaces on write, so old ones retire automatically instead of.
limit_zh: 只管决策记录的增删改档，不判断代码是否已死——那要另走 proving-code-is-dead；也不替你写记录内容。
limit_en: Only curates decision records' lifecycle, not whether code is dead (use proving-code-is-dead); it won't write records, only their relations and.
title_en: Keeps your decision records superseded, not stacked
